question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Get out of hand
solution:
The correct answer is** "Become difficult to control"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**to become chaotic and unmanageable, as of a situation**".
 
• We use the idiom "**get out of hand**" to refer to a situation that goes out of control and is not usually in the control of the people involved.
 
 
• **Example**: *His alcoholism used to **get out of hand **__before he was admitted to a rehabilitation facility*.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.
